C0559.title: Courier Rejects Main Product but Keeps Free Gifts, Profiting 380,000 Yuan and Receiving Prison Sentence
C0559.summary: Courier Sun exploited his delivery role by placing fake orders for digital products on an e-commerce platform, rejecting the main products while intercepting and reselling the bundled gifts. Beijing Political and Legal Affairs Network reported that the case involved more than 800 gifts worth over 380,000 yuan. After the Fengtai District Procuratorate brought the prosecution, the court convicted Sun of fraud and sentenced him to two years and ten months in prison, with a fine.
